enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Eyes closed. Breathe slowly. Turn to right side. Pull blanket over shoulder. Bend knees. Adjust pillow. Turn to back. Stretch arms. Turn to left side. Place hand under pillow. Remain still. Turn to right side. Pull blanket down. Turn to back. Breathe deeply. Remain still.

Wake up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Dry with towel. Brush teeth and wash face. Turn off light.
Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk, eggs, bread. Close refrigerator. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs. Cook eggs. Toast bread. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Clear dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing work bag
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt, pants. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open work bag. Place laptop in bag. Place stethoscope in bag. Zip bag.

Walk to bus stop. Check phone for time. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Bus stops. Get up. Exit bus. Walk to hospital entrance. Push door. Enter hospital.

enriched_activities.activity: Working a clinical shift as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital. Go to locker room. Change into scrubs. Hang up personal clothes. Walk to nurse station. Say 'Good morning' to colleague. Receive handover. Review patient charts. Walk to patient room 1. Knock. Enter. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Record notes. Walk to patient room 2. Knock. Enter. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Record notes.
Leave hospital. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Bus stops. Get up. Exit bus. Walk home. Enter home.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables, chicken. Close refrigerator. Chop vegetables. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil. Cook chicken. Add vegetables. Stir. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Clear dishes. Wash dishes.
Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Dry with towel. Put on clean clothes. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Select channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Get up. Walk to computer. Turn on computer. Check email. Turn off computer. Return to sofa. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing lunch for the next day and having a light snack
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out bread, cheese, lettuce. Close refrigerator. Slice cheese. Assemble sandwich. Place sandwich in container. Put container in refrigerator. Take out yogurt. Eat yogurt. Clear table. Wash spoon.

enriched_activities.activity: Brushing teeth and completing night routine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Apply moisturizer. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Wash hands. Turn off light.

Walk to bedroom. Turn off light. Lie in bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Bend knees. Stretch arms. Turn to back. Remain still. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Breathe deeply.
